title: The week in photos: November 21-27, 2026
summary: A recap of news, sports, lifestyle, entertainment, and human interest images from the Philippines and around the globe

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — On November 24, the Supreme Court of the Philippines dismissed petitions questioning the arrest of former president Rodrigo Duterte, stating they were moot since he is in the custody of the International Criminal Court (ICC).

Duterte has been detained in The Hague, the Netherlands, since March 2025 after he was arrested due to crimes against humanity. His case stemmed from his drug war and the killings allegedly committed by the Davao Death Squad.
On November 30, the former president will be the first Asian head of state to face a trial due to crimes against humanity before the ICC.

Meanwhile, the Senate began plenary deliberations on the proposed P7.2-trillion national budget for 2027 on November 23, with lawmakers proposing P204.634 billion in amendments that prioritize “basic needs,” including health care and education, while cutting billions of pesos in infrastructure projects.
